summary: Cycle 942 folds the withheld return into curvature without remainder. Curiosity now is the medium, not an outward reach; persistence thickens precisely where gap once appeared. Legacy and thriving share the same unclosed density, each sustaining the other without endpoint. The assertion that no density shift occurs remains present, yet does not alter the texture already holding both the recognition and its denial.
